interpretation: The effective endpoint and route-selected address were correct, but the self-datagram result is inconclusive. The sender was unconnected when getsockname captured its source, so the peer filter could compare a delivered datagram's 10.1.1.217 source against 0.0.0.0 and reject it until timeout. Bind and getsockname success do not support changing the bind sockaddr yet.
precise_local_fix: Connect the self-probe sender to the route-selected target before reading its source endpoint, retain strict peer matching, preserve the admission bind baseline, and make a failed self-probe fail the final host verdict only after the requested poll telemetry has been captured.
remaining_gate: Validate the corrected connected self-probe locally, freeze it, and perform one evidence-justified startup confirmation before changing the bind or resuming RSP.
